verdict.rationale: Floot's own site claims one-click publishing to a live shareable link: "Just one click 'publish' and you're live." The custom-domain docs confirm that apps are served from a *.floot.app subdomain by default. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the publish flow, independent or hands-on corroboration that one-click publish works as claimed.

support.subject: As a founder, I can publish my app to a live URL in one step

citations.quote: Put your app online instantly with its own shareable link. Just one click “publish” and you're live.
Point your own domain at your Floot app so it is served from your own address instead of its *.floot.app subdomain.
